criteria.name: Hook strength
criteria.notes: First two lines name asserter (Gov. Dunleavy), exact claim (4-5 cents/kWh), and the financial stake (budget off by tens of millions), inside the ~210-char see-more cutoff; minor outlet-name inconsistency (Data Center World vs Data Center Knowledge) prevents a 10.

criteria.name: Claim load-bearing + AK stakes
criteria.notes: Claim governs real capital decisions; names DigitalBridge, Stak Energy, Air Force EUL bidders, quantifies tens of millions per year per 100 MW, names 12-24 month horizon.

criteria.name: Steelman fairness
criteria.notes: Para 2 validates the mechanism (stranded gas + fuel-indexed PPA), cites Norway/Iceland/Quebec, affirms 'the claim is plausible' before rebuttal; no snark.

criteria.name: Counter-evidence quality
criteria.notes: All three rebuttal points trace to dossier counter_evidence: EIA Table 5.6.A (live-verified primary), EIA state profile (primary), Chugach/Hasquet via ADN.

criteria.name: Factual density
criteria.notes: Named specifics every 1-2 sentences: dates, EIA tables, 23.02/25.32/22.17 cents, Chugach, Hilcorp, 2028, Cook Inlet, 100 MW.

criteria.name: Source quality
criteria.notes: Claim attributed to named Governor with verbatim quote and date; counter-evidence on two independent live-verified EIA primary sources plus named-spokesperson utility quote; all in dossier.

criteria.name: Voice match
criteria.notes: Reads like post_001.md: analytical, corrective without contempt, structural (contingency vs rate sheet), CFO angle, no influencer cadence or banned phrases.

criteria.name: Readability (LinkedIn)
criteria.notes: 2-4 sentence paragraphs, single 3-item bullet block, 473 words, 2785 chars; the stakes paragraph runs slightly long as one sentence.

criteria.name: Engagement question
criteria.notes: Specific debatable question (what discount rate on a power price contingent on an unbuilt pipeline) tied to the corrected frame; no CTA.

criteria.name: Business actionability
criteria.notes: Reader can reframe three decisions from the bullet block: baseline 23-25 cents, treat 4-5 cents as upside, price Cook Inlet supply risk before 2028.

one_sentence_fix: Break the long single-sentence stakes paragraph into two sentences to remove the only scan-friction moment.
